hook.text: 11 p.m. One exercise. Stuck. Alone. That ends today.

chat.text: Chatbots hand you the answer. You learn nothing. And private tutors cost a fortune.

meet.text: Meet Gerald. The private tutor that lives on your screen.

td.text: Drop your courses. Gerald knows them, and reads your worksheet with you.

board.text: You write on the board. Gerald follows every line, explains out loud, plots the exact curve. And you find the answer yourself.

desktop.text: One key, any app. Gerald guides you step by step, all the way to the red square. And you do the clicking.

cta.text: Gerald. It doesn't give you the answer. It helps you find it.
